subject.title: Add package changelog previews for plugin publishing

question: Should ClawHub accept package release changelog auto-preview for authorized package publishers and staff, including use of prior release README content for preview generation?
rationale: The code can be reviewed for ordering and tests, but this contributor PR adds a new public action that can expose package README history to preview generation, so the permanent product/security boundary needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept gated preview after rebase
options.body: Resolve the current package backend conflict, keep the owner/publisher/staff gate before storage reads, fix the README prompt labels, and land the proven preview path.

options.title: Narrow the preview contract
options.body: Require stricter access, reduced README context, or explicit policy documentation before merging the preview action.

options.title: Keep changelogs manual-only
options.body: Pause or close this PR if automatic package release changelog previews are not desired for ClawHub.

recommendation.title: Accept gated preview after rebase
recommendation.body: Resolve the current package backend conflict, keep the owner/publisher/staff gate before storage reads, fix the README prompt labels, and land the proven preview path.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest current-main history across the package publish backend, plugin publish route, changelog helper, and staged publish conflict area.
